scope: Shared development source plus four isolated synthetic candidates. No hosted deployment or database/customer changes.
implemented: Optional stable creation UUID becomes customer primary ID; atomic INSERT rejects duplicate IDs as well as existing contact identity matches
Same-request replay returns authoritative current customer/history totals; conflicting saved details are never overwritten
Owner-only read-only confirmation endpoint returns exact customer by creation ID, privately and without cache
Add Customer persists only the save UUID before POST, not plaintext contact details; synchronous double-submit lock and locked uncertain form
After lost acknowledgement, read once to confirm; no automatic POST retry
After reload, check previous save using GET only. If never committed, deliberately re-enter using the same reserved ID
Changed saved details require explicit current-customer review; successful UI insertion deduplicates by customer ID
Navigation/unmount preserves pending recovery ID rather than clearing it through an old callback
